🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 16, 2026

Moon, in Aquarius, holds a sextile to Saturn, in its fall in Aries. Two ways of valuing a thing, meeting at one point: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 3-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. Moon sextiles you from Aquarius: help that waits to be asked for. Fire that starts things, started cheaply. Three weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. Moon squares you from Aquarius, and something has to give way. Earth that holds on, charged for holding. It has stood four weeks; by now the cost is known.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon trines you from Aquarius, and the ease asks its own attention. Mutable air keeps two accounts, and both balance. Sun let go of it two weeks ago.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you from Aquarius on plain terms, without privilege. From Libra, Venus sets a figure against the wanting. Water moves first and pays first. The hold Sun had a week ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Scorpio, untitled. From Aquarius, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Fixed fire: the grip is the expense. Four weeks of Libra ended, and nothing carried over.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Sun in Scorpio makes room for you, and then waits. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. Forward again for a week now, Mercury has left the old ground.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra and answers to nobody. Moon in Aquarius sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal air: beginning costs almost nothing. The Scorpio chapter closed four weeks ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon in Aquarius presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Fixed water: the grip costs more than the thing. The square to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon in Aquarius opens a gap you have to step into. Fire bends, and bending costs nothing here. The same angle for three weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Cardinal earth opens the account without argument. After three weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Air holds until owning and being coincide. Three weeks ago Saturn was still held by Mars; that is finished.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Scorpio, Mercury agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Water adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. What pressed a week ago has cleared.
